mapper.sql: CASE R.STATUS WHEN 'RECEIVED' THEN '접수' WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN '처리중' WHEN 'DONE' THEN '완료' ELSE R.STATUS END AS STATUS_NAME

SELECT R.REPORT_NO, R.MEMBER_NO, R.REPORTER_NAME, R.REPORTER_PHONE, R.TYPE_NO, R.ROUTE_NO, R.CONTENT, R.STATUS, R.REG_DATE, G.GROUP_NAME, T.TYPE_NAME,
FROM REPORT R INNER JOIN REPORT_TYPE T ON R.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO INNER JOIN REPORT_TYPE_GROUP G ON T.GROUP_NO = G.GROUP_NO
ORDER BY R.REPORT_NO ASC
ORDER BY R.REPORT_NO DESC
LIMIT #{displayDataCnt} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT R.REPORT_NO, R.MEMBER_NO, R.REPORTER_NAME, R.REPORTER_PHONE, R.TYPE_NO, R.ROUTE_NO, R.CONTENT, R.STATUS, R.REG_DATE, R.ANSWER, R.ANSWER_DATE, G.GROUP_NAME, T.TYPE_NAME,
FROM REPORT R INNER JOIN REPORT_TYPE T ON R.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO INNER JOIN REPORT_TYPE_GROUP G ON T.GROUP_NO = G.GROUP_NO WHERE R.REPORT_NO = #{reportNo}

UPDATE REPORT
STATUS = #{status},
ANSWER = #{answer}, ANSWER_DATE = NOW(),
WHERE REPORT_NO = #{reportNo}
mapper.sql: REG_DATE >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND REG_DATE < CURDATE()
mapper.select: SELECT '접수' AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM REPORT WHERE STATUS = 'RECEIVED' UNION ALL SELECT '처리중', COUNT(*) FROM REPORT WHERE STATUS = 'PROCESSING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORT WHERE STATUS = 'DONE' AND ANSWER_DATE >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND ANSWER_DATE < CURDATE()
SELECT ROUTE_NO AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM REPORT WHERE GROUP BY ROUTE_NO ORDER BY CNT DESC, ROUTE_NO LIMIT 10
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM REPORT WHERE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY LABEL

SELECT R.ROUTE_NO, T.TYPE_NAME, R.STATUS, R.CONTENT FROM REPORT R INNER JOIN REPORT_TYPE T ON R.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO WHERE R.REG_DATE >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND R.REG_DATE < CURDATE() ORDER BY R.REG_DATE DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT T.TYPE_NAME AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM REPORT R INNER JOIN REPORT_TYPE T ON R.TYPE_NO = T.TYPE_NO WHERE R.REG_DATE >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND R.REG_DATE < CURDATE() GROUP BY T.TYPE_NO, T.TYPE_NAME ORDER BY CNT DESC, T.TYPE_NO LIMIT 10
SELECT ROUTE_NO, ROUTE_NAME FROM BUS_ROUTE WHERE ROUTE_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ROUTE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY ROUTE_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE BUS_ROUTE SET ROUTE_NAME = #{routeName} WHERE ROUTE_NO = #{routeNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORT WHERE ROUTE_NO = #{routeNo}
